messages:
Claire (CS): Heads-up: Ganymede reserved pool goes live next Wed 03/25. Need final quota lock, autoscale policy, and loadtest window. Pinged infra earlier.
Ashley: Got it. What numbers are we committing? customer expects steady 450 rps, peaks 1.2k during morning window.
Ravi: From infra side, current pool = 8 A100s. With current packing, that's ~600 rps at p99 < 200ms for model 'redwood-medium'. Need to know headroom target and burst policy.
Marco: Model variant: we'll serve quantized v1.2; perf test shows ~1.1k rps at 95th if we enable batch size 8 and prefix cache. But kv-cache warmup matters.
Claire (CS): Customer SLA requires 99.9% availability and <250ms p95. They want canary first 2 hours with shadow 20% traffic.
Ashley: @Ravi can we add a canary slot? Also need quota adjustment for 1.2k peak.
Ravi: Yes. I can reserve a canary pool (2 GPUs). Autoscale policy: min 6 GPUs, max 12. Warmup script will prepopulate kv-cache for top 50 prefixes.
Marco: I can run perf harness. Will upload load script: `scripts/ganymede_load.yml` with ramp 0->1.2k over 15min, steady 30min, ramp down 15min.
Ashley: I'll coordinate customer enablement and confirm traffic patterns + test tokens.
Ravi: Opsbot run: `reserve-pool --name ganymede-canary --gpus 2 --start 2026-03-20T02:00Z --end 2026-03-20T06:00Z`
Ops Bot: reserved pool ganymede-canary id cny-482 available :white_check_mark:
Claire (CS): Two asks: (1) a short runbook for escalation if latency > 300ms, (2) capture logs for token-level cost for postmortem.
Ashley: Working on runbook. I'll include: rollback to 'redwood-small' variant, shift traffic to fallback region eu-west-1, and paging list.
Ravi: I'll add Prometheus alerts: `redwood_latency_p95 > 300ms for 2m` and `pool_gpu_util > 90%`.
Marco: Reminder: ensure model kv cache TTL is >= 12h during warmup, otherwise we'll lose benefits.
Claire (CS): Final confirmations: Marco upload script and perf results by EOD Tue, Ravi reserve pool and alerts, Ashley confirm with customer. Post test we'll do a 1-week monitoring window.
Ashley: Confirmed. I'll also run a quick customer training on failover steps.
Ravi: Done: pool reserved (id cny-482), alerts configured, canary autoscale set.
Marco: Perf harness uploaded: https://internal.s3/redwood/ganymede_load_2026-03-18.json — Achieves 1.15k rps p95 220ms with batch=8.
Claire (CS): Perfect. I'll send calendar invites and ops playbook draft.
Ashley: :thumbsup: Thanks team.
